description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the PersonAddressValidator class in the OpenMRS project. It tests validation logic for PersonAddress objects, including date validation, required fields, field length constraints, and overall validation behavior.

classes.name: PersonAddressValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for PersonAddressValidator, checking various validation scenarios for PersonAddress objects.

methods.name: runBeforeAllTests
methods.description: Initializes the validator and retrieves the PersonService before each test.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheStartDateIsInTheFuture
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the start date of the address is set in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheEndDateIsBeforeTheStartDate
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the end date is before the start date.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAllTheDatesAreValid
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when start and end dates are equal and valid.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfStartDateAndEndDateAreBothNull
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when both start and end dates are null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfStartDateIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when start date is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfEndDateIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when end date is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfRequiredFieldsAreEmpty
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if required address fields are empty.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfRequiredFieldsAreNotEmpty
methods.description: Tests that validation passes if required fields are populated.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks that the validator accepts fields with correct length.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that the validator rejects fields with excessively long text.
